data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month: 50 × 10 = 500 tons caught, leaving 500, so next month's stock returns to 1,000 under either replenishment outcome. That gives each of us $10,000 monthly without risking the fishery. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support it; we can review revealed catches afterward.
